'''March 2002 Levittown tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Tri-County, Levittown, NY on 30 March 2002. [[Sam Diamond]] won it. It is known from Chris Wodicka's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3542">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-03-30-levittown-ny-3-30-02d3542/ levittown-ny-3-30-02], DeckTech (Chris "Wedge231" Wodicka, 30 March 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-03-30-levittown-ny-3-30-02d3542/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 30 March 2002
* '''Site:''' Tri-County, Levittown, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Players:''' 4
* '''Winner:''' [[Sam Diamond]]
